cases.name: set_auto_marks_middle_key_and_splines_both_neighbouring_segments
cases.comment: Former smooth_one_incoming_from_elastic_reads_diagonal, first half: modes flip to Auto, continuity Smooth, this key's and the previous key's segment become Spline (the Elastic is replaced), coordinates untouched.

cases.name: solve_middle_key_on_ramp_reproduces_smooth_numbers
cases.comment: Second half: m = (2 − 0) / 2 s; out.y = m·1 s / (3·1) = 1/3 and in.y = 1 − 1/3 = 2/3 — the former p1.y / p2.y exactly. The neighbours' Free sides stay identity.

cases.name: set_auto_peak_marks_middle_key
cases.comment: Former smooth_one_peak, first half.

cases.name: solve_peak_middle_key
cases.comment: Second half: the middle key is a local maximum → m = 0 → out.y = 0, in.y = 1 (the former p1.y / p2.y). animatedGolden `auto_solved_peak_middle_key_only` evaluates this result.

cases.name: solve_all_keys_auto_peak
cases.comment: Every key Auto (set_auto over all three ids, then solve). Endpoints have m = 0: the first key's out is (1/3, 0); the last key's in is (2/3, 1 − 0) = (2/3, 1). The first key's in and the last key's out have no segment to solve against and keep the identity coords with mode Auto. animatedGolden `auto_solved_peak_all_keys_auto` evaluates this result.

cases.name: solve_leaves_auto_sides_next_to_non_spline_segments_alone
cases.comment: An Auto out on a Hold segment is never read by the engine, so the solver leaves its coordinates as stored.

cases.name: solve_smooth_free_pair_out_wins
cases.comment: Middle key Smooth with two Free sides on a 0 → 1 → 2 ramp (1 s steps). out = (1/3, 1/3) → slope m = (1/3)/(1/3)·(1/1 s) = 1 per s; in.x = 2/3 kept, in.y = 1 − m·(1 − 2/3)·1 s/1 = 2/3 (was 0).

cases.name: upsert_with_easing_writes_spline_across_the_pair
cases.comment: Inserting between two Linear keys with ease_in: the new key takes Spline + out = p1, the next key's in = p2, both Free; the preceding key is untouched.

cases.name: set_segment_easing_on_last_key_writes_left_only
cases.comment: The last key has no right neighbour: only its own class and leaving side are written.

cases.name: retime_keeps_extrapolate
cases.comment: Every edit carries the track-level extrapolation through unchanged.

cases.name: set_tangent_out_writes_free_and_splines_the_leaving_segment
cases.comment: Writing the leaving side of a Linear key: the side is stored Free as given, the segment leaving the key becomes Spline so it is read, the next key is untouched.

cases.name: set_tangent_in_splines_the_arriving_segment
cases.comment: Writing the arriving side of the last key: the PREVIOUS key’s segment becomes Spline (it owns the segment this side shapes); that key’s own out stays the identity.

cases.name: set_tangent_clamps_x_and_frees_an_auto_key
cases.comment: Middle key marked Auto/Smooth by set_auto (identity numbers). Grabbing its out handle at x = 1.5 clamps x to 1 and converts BOTH sides to Free; Smooth then rotates in: m = out.y/out.x · dvNext/dtNext = 0.5 · 1/1 s, in.y = 1 − m·(1 − 2/3)·1 s/1 = 1 − 0.5/3 = 0.8333…

cases.name: set_tangent_in_rotates_out_when_smooth
cases.comment: Smooth middle key, both sides Free identity. Writing in = (2/3, 0): the arriving slope is (1 − 0)/(1 − 2/3) · 1/1 s = 3 per s, so out.y = 3 · out.x · 1 s / 1 = 3 · 1/3 = 1 with out.x kept.

cases.name: set_tangent_out_rotates_in_when_smooth
cases.comment: The mirror image: writing out = (1/3, 1) gives slope 1/(1/3) · 1/1 s = 3 per s, so in.y = 1 − 3 · (1 − 2/3) · 1 s / 1 = 0 with in.x kept — exactly the pair main’s out-wins solve produces.

cases.name: set_tangent_smooth_skips_a_flat_opposite_segment
cases.comment: The arriving segment is flat (1 → 1), so no finite in.y matches any slope: the written out lands, in keeps the identity.

cases.name: set_continuity_smooth_rotates_in_to_out
cases.comment: Broken middle key with out = (1/3, 1) and identity in; switching to Smooth re-aims in from out (out wins): slope 3 per s → in.y = 1 − 3·(1/3)·1 = 0.

cases.name: set_continuity_broken_keeps_every_number
cases.comment: Broken is a flag flip: both sides stay exactly as stored.

cases.name: set_extrapolation_patches_one_side
cases.comment: Only the named side changes; keys are untouched.

cases.name: set_extrapolation_static_is_unchanged
cases.comment: A Static track has no extrapolation to patch.
